issues.description: The problem statement UML and task description specify addGuestStudents(int) as a void method, but the solution implementation declares addGuestStudents(int) returning boolean. This creates a signature mismatch that can confuse students about the expected return type and behavior of the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type of addGuestStudents(int) across all artifacts. Either (A) update the solution to match the UML/task by changing the method signature to public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) and perform the addition without returning a value (handle invalid inputs by no-op or throwing as appropriate), or (B) update the UML and problem text to document a boolean return type that indicates success/failure and keep the solution signature. Ensure the template's TODO and any tests reflect the chosen signature.
